replies.text: I’m native but. Some people get consumed by alcohol, well a lot, but there is a lot of miners fishermen and very hard workers. A bunch of the drunks are hard workers if they pull themselves out. True there are lots of drunk natives but there is a more making a living and doing well.

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: Living somewhere that depends on supply barges during the short summer must take a lot of planning😵‍💫😵‍💫. Anyone from Nome know what families usually stock up on before winter?🥶

replies.author: @frankamaktoolik6272
replies.text:
There are cargo planes and commercial airlines but it’s expensive. Families stock up on fish berries  greens spring and fall marine mammals such as seals and beluga(only what’s needed no excess slaughtering) also birds spring and fall seasonal moose hunts with quotas, caribou, some communities have reindeer heards. Lucky if you get a musk ox tag rabbits ptarmigan some trap and hunt furs to sale as well winter time. Bad punctuation but you get the gist of it?
Edit: Growing up and living it it doesn’t seem so dramatic but once you learn the outside world it can feel pretty isolated and hard to fathom some of the things we do lol
